text: For Gavilan College Trustee Area 3, Gabriel Gutierrez holds a CAIR Action general-election endorsement and, per a community report, supports divesting from Israel. His platform centers on free tuition, student housing, collective bargaining, and expanded student services. Shahida S. Merchant runs on counseling and advising, basic-needs support, degree and transfer pathways, workforce programs, and budget transparency. Gutierrez is the only candidate in this race with a documented pro-Palestine-aligned endorsement and a reported divestment position.
